comment: The word-lock on the muniment room's door in the King's Tower (WISHLIST.md, Phase 4). The Scholar posed the old one; a door does not talk, so the wrong-answer lines are the lock not moving. judgeAnswer, the hint after two wrong answers and the overlay are untouched.
riddle: Carved above the lock: I run and never walk, I have a bed and never sleep, a mouth and never speak, a head and never think. Say my name.
hint: It came down off the mountain before the castle did, and it is still going past the walls.
wrongAnswerResponses: Nothing moves. The word is cut in the stone and the stone does not care what you said.
The lock stays shut. Whatever the answer is, it was here before the tower was.
Still shut. Read the carving again — it is all bed and mouth and head, and none of it is a man.
